skill_name: Create a blog post about airplane safety.
workflow: Airplane safety is of paramount importance, from the the aircraft itself to the passengers that are transported in it. A few precautions and tips can help ensure everyone's safety while traveling by plane. Before boarding and preparing to take off, make sure you have read all the safety regulations provided with your ticket and familiarized yourself with them.
